name: Lebrija
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: An Andalusia appellation in Seville province, covering the municipalities of Lebrija and El Cuervo de Sevilla. Rules allow wine from Palomino, Moscatel and Tempranillo among others.
